content.text:
summarise in 2 sentences:

The city council voted on Tuesday to approve a new bike lane network spanning 40 kilometres across the downtown core. Supporters argued that the lanes will reduce traffic fatalities, which rose 12 percent last year, and cut commuting times for the roughly 18,000 residents who already cycle daily. Opponents, mostly local business owners, warned that removing street parking could hurt sales, citing a similar project in a neighbouring town where foot traffic dipped for six months before recovering. The final plan includes protected barriers on major arteries, 600 new bike racks, and a pilot loading-zone programme for delivery trucks. Construction begins in March and is expected to take two years, funded by a mix of federal transit grants and a modest increase in parking fees.
